title: dedicated-autoscaler: SLO fallback, graceful burst controls, and utilization reporting
author: Priya Sharma
description: Adds SLO-aware fallback routing for Dedicated autoscaler and improved burst utilization reporting. Motivation: customers observed tail latency spikes during short high-QPS bursts which caused missed SLOs and noisy paging. This PR implements a graceful SLO fallback path that shifts traffic from throughput-optimized to latency-optimized pools when queueing likelihood exceeds configured thresholds, adds token-bucket smoothing to minimize oscillation during short bursts, and extends utilization reporting to include burst credit usage and pre/post-fallback snapshots so ops can audit decisions. Changes are gated behind a feature flag (autoscaler.slo_fallback=true) and include migration notes for existing Dedicated configs. Linked Linear: ENG-3124 (autoscaler SLO fallback), ENG-3250 (utilization reporting), PM-198 (customer impact). Checklist: [x] design doc linked, [x] unit tests, [x] integration test harness, [x] dashboard tiles, [x] rollout plan. Rollout: stage on canary capacity, monitor utilization and latencies for 48h, then enable globally. Backout: revert feature flag and redeploy autoscaler binary. See commits for implementation details and CI logs for test results.
